items.title_en: Foreign Investors Heavily Buy Panel Tigers, Dump Financial Stocks; Three Major Institutional Investors Net Bought 22 Billion TWD
paras: 台股今(9)日開高後一度大漲超過440點，尾盤呈現高檔震盪後收紅走勢，終場收在47,183點，上漲77點，成交量較縮減至7,735億元。據證交所盤後資訊顯示，外資今日加碼買超209.24億元，看好面板股在本(9)月上旬面板價格預測將隨著年底促銷旺季備貨需求回溫，加上上游零組件成本維持高檔，掃進群創(3481-TW)8.1萬張、友達(2049-TW) 6.5萬張，也買進主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)、主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)等2檔主動式ETF操作。
觀察今日三大法人動向，外資單日買超209.24億元、投信加碼買超 30.4億元、自營商賣超18.84億元，三大法人合計買超 220.81億元。外資期貨部分，外資空單減少1,196口，累計期貨空單仍高達8.1萬口。
在外資今日動向上，買超前10名中，以群創位居首位8.19萬張最高、友達6.57萬張，主動統一台股增長 1.94萬張、新纖1.79萬張、台泥1.74萬張、聯電1.46萬張、臺企銀1.33萬張、台塑化1.32萬張，廣達、台塑化各自買超約1.3萬張。
外資賣超前10名中，共6檔為金融股，賣超最多為華邦電5.79萬張、台新新光金3.24萬張、凱基金2.19萬張、玉山金2萬張、彰銀12.9萬張，台中銀及1.17萬張、中信金1.13萬張、至上 9,362張、沛爾生醫*-創6,626張、復華富時不動產(00712-TW) 6,111張。
投信買超前10名中則有6家為金融股，與外資對作，買最多為台新新光金2.03萬張、其次為凱基金8,068 張、聯電5,044張、玉山金3,131張、統一證2,228張、至上1,986張、第一金1,612張、台勝科1,401張、中信金1,348 張、興富發1,342 張。
投信賣超前10名中，以華通4,529張賣最多、其次遠東新2,297張、遠東銀2,253張、緯創1,865張、群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)1,800張、聯鈞1,406張、緯穎1,016張、光寶科、微星、智邦。
法人表示，以技術面來看，台股今日開高後一路向上到近昨(8)日高點，但未能有效突破，隨後一路走低至接近平盤，顯示4萬7,500點仍是明顯壓力區，以整體趨勢結構觀察，加權指數收盤仍守短、中、長期均線之上，均線排列尚未轉弱，代表中期多頭格局暫時沒有遭到破壞，只要回檔未跌破短期均線及4萬7千點整數關卡，仍可視為漲多後的技術性整理，而非趨勢反轉訊號。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks opened higher today (the 9th) and surged over 440 points at one point, ending the session with a high‑range oscillation and a red close, finishing at 47,183 points, up 77 points, with turnover shrinking to TWD 7.735 trillion. Post‑market data from the exchange shows foreign investors increased net buying by TWD 20.924 billion, optimistic that panel stock prices in early September will rebound with year‑end promotional season inventory demand, while upstream component costs remain high, snapping up 81,000 lots of Innolux (3481‑TW) and 65,000 lots of AU Optronics (2049‑TW), and also purchasing two active ETFs: Unified Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW) and Unified Taiwan Stock Growth (00981A‑TW).

Observing today’s three major institutional investors, foreign investors net bought TWD 20.924 billion, investment trusts added net buying of TWD 3.04 billion, while dealers sold net TWD 1.884 billion, totaling a net purchase of TWD 22.081 billion. In the futures segment, foreign investors reduced short positions by 1,196 contracts, but cumulative futures shorts remain high at 81,000 contracts.

Among the top ten net‑buy stocks by foreign investors, Innolux led with 81,900 lots, followed by AU Optronics with 65,700 lots, Unified Taiwan Stock Growth with 19,400 lots, New Fiber with 17,900 lots, Taiwan Cement with 17,400 lots, United Microelectronics with 14,600 lots, Taiwan Business Bank with 13,300 lots, Formosa Plastics Corp. (chemical) with 13,200 lots, and both Quanta Computer and Formosa Plastics Corp. (chemical) each net bought about 13,000 lots.

In the foreign investors’ top ten net‑sell list, six were financial stocks. The biggest seller was Winbond Electronics with 57,900 lots, followed by Taishin Financial Holding & Shin Kong Financial with 32,400 lots, KGI Securities with 21,900 lots, E.SUN Financial Holding with 20,000 lots, Chang Hwa Bank with 12,900 lots, Taichung Bank with 11,700 lots, CTBC Financial Holding with 11,300 lots, Shang Shin with 9,362 lots, Pei Er Biotech‑Chuang with 6,626 lots, and Fuhua FT Real Estate (00712‑TW) with 6,111 lots.

Among the top ten net‑buy stocks by investment trusts, six were financial stocks, mirroring foreign investors’ moves. The biggest buyer was Taishin Financial Holding & Shin Kong Financial with 20,300 lots, followed by KGI Securities with 8,068 lots, United Microelectronics with 5,044 lots, E.SUN Financial Holding with 3,131 lots, Uni-President Securities with 2,228 lots, Shang Shin with 1,986 lots, First Financial Holding with 1,612 lots, Tai Sheng Technology with 1,401 lots, CTBC Financial Holding with 1,348 lots, and Xing Fu Development with 1,342 lots.

In the investment trusts’ top ten net‑sell list, the biggest seller was Wistron with 4,529 lots, followed by Far Eastern New Century with 2,297 lots, Far Eastern Bank with 2,253 lots, Wistron with 1,865 lots, Yuanta Taiwan High‑Yield Selection (00919‑TW) with 1,800 lots, Lianjun with 1,406 lots, Wistron with 1,016 lots, and then Lite‑On Technology, MSI, and ZyXEL each sold notable amounts.

Institutional commentary noted that technically, the market opened higher and rose toward yesterday’s (the 8th) high but failed to break through, then fell back toward the flat line, indicating that the 47,500‑point level remains a clear resistance zone. Looking at the overall trend structure, the index closed still above the short‑, medium‑ and long‑term moving averages, whose arrangement has not weakened, suggesting the medium‑term bullish pattern remains intact. As long as any pullback does not breach the short‑term average and the 47,000‑point round‑number level, the move can be seen as a technical consolidation after the rally rather than a trend‑reversal signal.

items.title: VIX安靜得太詭異！美股像「沒繫安全帶飆車」 瑞銀示警一撞恐出大事
items.title_en: VIX Is Too Quietly Odd! U.S. Stocks Like a 'Seatbelt‑less Speeding Car'—UBS Warns a Crash Could Trigger Big Trouble
paras: 距離美國11月3日期中選舉僅剩兩個月，美股卻在政治與政策風險升高之際展現近乎「無所畏懼」的樂觀情緒。分析師警告，選擇權市場正浮現脆弱性與無懼情緒並存的危險組合，一旦意外事件引發震盪，市場可能缺乏足夠緩衝。
《路透》周三(9日)報導，儘管近期債市劇烈波動，美股仍徘徊歷史高點附近，波動率指標接近2026年低點，個股相關性也逼近歷史低位，顯示股票走勢較以往更加分散。分析師普遍不認為選舉結果本身會引發巨大市場反應，但9月至10月的選前階段可能充滿波動。
隨著投票日逼近，投資人焦點可能轉向國會控制權及其政策影響，包括美國是否出現分裂政府或執政基礎不穩等風險。歷史經驗顯示，期中選舉前的9月至10月原本就是美股容易震盪的時期，原因是市場告別夏季淡季後，投資人開始重新評估政治風險。

VIX未反映選舉風險 市場幾乎毫無戒心

Cantor Fitzgerald統計，自1930年以來的24個期中選舉年中，標普500指數有15次在9月至10月期間下跌至少5%。然而，目前波動率期貨幾乎看不出投資人的憂慮。
被視為市場恐慌指標的芝加哥選擇權交易所波動率指數(VIX)近期觸及今年新低，目前約為15，低於17.6的長期中位數。VIX期貨同樣保持平靜，反映投資人相信強勁企業獲利仍能支撐美股。
Tallbacken Capital Advisors執行長Michael Purves表示，VIX期貨曲線完全沒有納入期中選舉的風險溢價。
然而，未來兩個月的行事曆充滿潛在催化劑，包括通膨與就業數據、聯準會(Fed)利率會議，以及中國國家主席習近平9月底訪美，最後才是期中選舉。
《路透》與益普索(Ipsos) 民調顯示，在處理生活成本議題方面，選民對民主黨的信任度已明顯領先共和黨，對總統川普所屬政黨構成警訊。Evercore ISI股票及量化策略主管Julian Emanuel指出，若民主黨奪回眾議院，美國將從共和黨全面掌控白宮與國會，轉為分裂政府，市場不確定性可能升高；若參議院也翻盤，影響將進一步放大。

UBS模型亮紅燈 意外衝擊恐放大跌勢

市場過度無懼，加上投資部位擁擠、信用利差偏窄及避險需求有限，顯示投資人可能尚未為衝擊做好準備。瑞銀(UBS)利用機器學習預測未來一個月市場脆弱程度的「Turbu-lens」模型，8月底已升至最高壓力等級。
UBS美國股票衍生性商品研究主管Maxwell Grinacoff表示，該模型過去數周幾乎一直對「極端脆弱」狀態發出警報。他形容，現在的市場就像沒繫安全帶、以時速100英里在高速公路上駕駛卡丁車，或許能平安抵達終點，但一旦遭到撞擊，後果恐怕十分嚴重。
SimCorp亞太投資決策研究主管Olivier d’Assier也指出，現行市場機制完全沒有預期任何衝擊。儘管美股至今未受地緣政治緊張及債市重挫明顯影響，分析師擔憂市場已沒有多少犯錯空間。
部分投資人則認為，只要企業獲利與經濟成長維持強勁，選舉結果不至於破壞美股基本面。過去3年做空者屢遭虧損，也使投資人不願再次押注下跌。不過Emanuel認為，相較期中選舉帶來的風險，目前隱含波動率仍相當便宜，想為未來兩個月行情避險的投資人，可能正迎來成本較低的布局時機。
paras_en: With only two months left until the U.S. November 3 midterm elections, the stock market is showing almost fearless optimism despite rising political and policy risks. Analysts warn that the options market is displaying a dangerous mix of fragility and bravado, and a shock‑induced swing could leave the market without enough cushion.

Reuters reported on Wednesday the 9th that, despite recent bond‑market turbulence, U.S. equities are still hovering near historic highs, with volatility indicators close to their 2026 lows and stock correlations approaching historic lows, indicating a more dispersed rally. Analysts generally do not expect the election outcome itself to spark a massive market reaction, but the pre‑election period from September to October could be volatile.

As the voting day approaches, investors’ focus may shift to control of Congress and its policy impact, including risks of a divided government or an unstable governing base. History shows that September‑October, the months before a midterm, are traditionally shaky for U.S. stocks as the market exits the summer lull and investors reassess political risk.

Cantor Fitzgerald data show that in 15 of the 24 midterm election years since 1930, the S&P 500 fell at least 5% during September‑October. Yet current volatility futures show almost no sign of investor worry.

The Chicago Board Options Exchange’s VIX, the market’s fear gauge, has recently hit a new low for the year, sitting around 15, below its long‑term median of 17.6. VIX futures are equally calm, reflecting investors’ belief that strong corporate earnings can still support equities.
Michael Purves, CEO of Tallbacken Capital Advisors, said the VIX futures curve completely omits any risk premium for the midterm election.

However, the next two months are packed with potential catalysts, including inflation and employment data, the Fed’s rate meeting, Chinese President Xi Jinping’s late‑September visit to the United States, and finally the midterms themselves.

A Reuters‑Ipsos poll shows that on the cost‑of‑living issue, voters trust the Democratic Party significantly more than the Republicans, a warning sign for the party of former President Trump. Julian Emanuel, head of equities and quantitative strategy at Evercore ISI, noted that if Democrats retake the House, the U.S. would shift from a unified Republican control of the White House and Congress to a divided government, raising market uncertainty; a Senate flip would amplify the effect further.

UBS’s machine‑learning “Turbu‑lens” model, which predicts market fragility over the next month, hit its highest stress level at the end of August, flashing a red light for potential shock‑driven declines.

Maxwell Grinacoff, head of U.S. equity derivatives research at UBS, said the model has been issuing “extremely fragile” alerts for weeks. He likened the market to a go‑kart traveling at 100 mph on a highway without a seatbelt—maybe it can reach the finish line, but a collision would be disastrous.

Olivier d’Assier, head of Asia‑Pacific investment‑decision research at SimCorp, added that current market mechanisms do not anticipate any shock. Although U.S. stocks have so far escaped obvious impacts from geopolitical tension and bond‑market sell‑offs, analysts worry there is little room for error left.

Some investors argue that as long as corporate earnings and economic growth stay strong, the election outcome won’t damage the fundamentals of U.S. stocks. The past three years have seen short sellers repeatedly lose money, making investors reluctant to bet on a decline. Yet Emanuel believes that, compared with the risks of the midterms, implied volatility remains cheap, offering a low‑cost hedging opportunity for those looking to protect positions over the next two months.

items.title: SK海力士Q4擬砸40兆韓元回購？標普：AI記憶體需求強勁、股東回報再升級
items.title_en: SK Hynix May Announce Up to 40 Trillion Won Buyback in Q4? S&P: AI Memory Demand Strong, Shareholder Returns Upgraded
paras: 標普全球市場情報（S&P Global Market Intelligence）最新預測指出，受人工智慧（AI）帶動記憶體晶片需求強勁、景氣持續升溫的支撐，SK海力士(000660KS) 可能在今年第4季宣布新一輪股票回購計畫，規模預估介於20兆至40兆韓元（約280億美元）。
標普認為，SK海力士近期強化股東回報的作法，正逐漸從一次性的市場刺激措施，轉向更制度化、常態化的回饋機制。
SK海力士先前已執行一項規模達40兆韓元的股票回購及註銷計畫，並承諾將超過50%的自由現金流（FCF）用於回饋股東。
市場預期，SK海力士若再次啟動大規模庫藏股回購，在強勁現金流支撐下，仍有能力維持可觀的股息發放，可能進一步強化南韓政府推動的「企業價值提升」（Value-up）政策，也為韓股股東回報行情增添動能。
南韓政府近年積極推動「企業價值提升」計畫，希望透過庫藏股註銷、提高股息等措施改善企業治理與股東回報，以降低南韓資本市場長期存在的「南韓折價」。
三星電子(005930KS) 此前已註銷逾8,700萬股庫藏股，並推出大規模股息計畫，被視為響應政策方向的代表性案例。
標普亞太股票股息預測主管Mohammad Hassan接受採訪時表示，SK海力士下一輪回購規模至少可能達20兆韓元，不排除再次達到40兆韓元的上限。
相關預期帶動SK海力士ADR(SKHY-US) 股價走強，週二（8日）大漲逾6%，收在187.99美元；週三（9日）韓股開盤後，SK海力士股價一度上漲5%。
Hassan同時預期，今年第4季可能有更多南韓上市企業宣布股票回購計畫。他指出，愈來愈多企業可能跟進，因為這將逐步為上市公司建立更高的投資人回報標準。
他認為，三星電子創紀錄的股息政策，加上SK海力士逐步常態化的股票回購，可能為南韓企業的市值管理與公司治理建立新的標準，並對整體南韓股市帶來正面影響。
paras_en: S&P Global Market Intelligence’s latest forecast says that, driven by strong AI‑fueled demand for memory chips and a warming economy, SK Hynix (000660.KS) could announce a new share‑repurchase program in the fourth quarter of this year, sized at roughly 20‑40 trillion won (about $28 billion).
S&P believes that SK Hynix’s recent moves to boost shareholder returns are shifting from one‑off market‑stimulus actions toward a more institutionalized, regularised feedback mechanism.
SK Hynix has previously carried out a share‑repurchase and cancellation program worth 40 trillion won and pledged to use more than 50 % of its free cash flow for shareholder returns.

The market expects that if SK Hynix launches another large‑scale buyback, its strong cash flow will still allow it to maintain sizable dividend payouts, potentially reinforcing the South Korean government’s “Value‑up” corporate‑value‑enhancement policy and adding momentum to the Korean‑stock shareholder‑return rally.

In recent years the South Korean government has been actively promoting a “Value‑up” agenda, aiming to improve corporate governance and shareholder returns through share cancellations, higher dividends and other measures to reduce the long‑standing “Korea discount” in its capital markets.
Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) has already cancelled more than 87 million treasury shares and launched a massive dividend program, seen as a flagship example of aligning with the policy direction.

Mohammad Hassan, head of Asia‑Pacific dividend forecasting at S&P, told reporters that SK Hynix’s next buyback could be at least 20 trillion won, and it would not be surprising if it reaches the 40 trillion‑won ceiling again.

The expectations helped lift SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) shares, which jumped more than 6 % on Tuesday the 8th to close at $187.99, and on Wednesday the 9th the Korean‑stock price rose as much as 5 % after the market opened.

Hassan also forecast that more South Korean listed companies may announce share‑repurchase plans in Q4, noting that an increasing number of firms are likely to follow suit as this gradually sets higher investor‑return standards for listed companies.

He believes that Samsung’s record‑setting dividend policy, combined with SK Hynix’s move toward a regularised buyback regime, could establish new benchmarks for market‑cap management and corporate governance among Korean firms and have a positive impact on the overall South Korean stock market.

items.title: 34年前「金融偷獵者」 大獲全勝 貝森特改換角色當莊家
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)本周展現出極具戰術性的貨幣政策風格，公開向外匯交易員喊話，大膽宣告「我現在就是莊家」。他強調自己對日本央行與日本政策制定者的行動擁有「資訊不對稱」優勢，並直接挑戰市場交易員敢不敢與他作對。
這種將主導權掌握在手的強硬作風，深深植根於他34年前協助索羅斯「擊潰英格蘭銀行」的頂尖避險基金經歷。
據《Fortune》記者Eva Roytburg報導，1992年時年僅29歲的貝森特洞察到英格蘭銀行的致命弱點：央行承諾將英鎊維持在歐洲匯率機制(ERM)的狹幅區間內，但透過升息來保衛匯率的做法，會嚴重打擊當時持有浮動利率房貸的英國屋主。
貝森特成功說服老闆索羅斯對英鎊發動大規模做空，最終迫使英國退出ERM，並為基金賺進10億美元利潤。Roytburg總結，貝森特從中汲取的關鍵教訓是：「當央行人為將貨幣維持在市場無法支持的水準時，市場最終將會獲勝」。
34年後，貝森特角色互換，從昔日的「金融偷獵者」變成了坐鎮局面的「金融護林員」。據報導，貝森特目前正與日本當局協調購買日元，且他多次暗示希望東京當局調升利率，而非僅依賴反覆干預。在他的警告與干預下，美元兌日元匯率已從2026年7月的163上方，一路回落至9月8日的153.96。
然而，這套強硬手法也在內部引發質疑；昔日索羅斯時期的同僚Stanley Druckenmiller公開指責他介入債券市場是個錯誤，而貝森特則反駁稱，擴大買回舊美債旨在冷卻美國公債市場的「發燒」現象。
據《路透》報導，日本央行預計在即將召開的會議上提高基準利率，這成為驗證貝森特威懾是否有效的即時測試。若日本當局順利升息，貝森特的豪賭就能成立；若日本猶豫不決，這位曾寫下狙擊央行教科書的掌權者，將親自驗證市場規律是否會反噬自己。

items.title: 8月定期定額創歷史次高 0050、0056攜手霸榜市值型、高股息ETF雙冠
paras: 隨著台股8月大漲逾3,000點，單月定期定額投資金額衝上歷史次高。指標ETF元大台灣50(0050-TW)與元大高股息(0056-TW)表現亮眼，8月定期定額戶數分別跨越128萬及33.8萬大關，攜手再創新高，成為國人存股配置的首選標的。
據證交所公布，8月定期定額金額368億元，創歷史次高，戶數排行由0050、0056分別以月增3.8萬、1.9萬，總人數來到128萬、33.8萬新高，分居市值型、高股息ETF之冠。其次為國泰永續高股息(00878-TW)、富邦台50(006208-TW)與群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)，定期定額人數分別為31.3萬、25.7萬及16.5萬。
統計8月定期定額標的前20名，總戶數來到307萬人，0050、0056佔逾半數，成為投資人資產配置中市值型、高股息ETF的首選標的。
法人分析，0050為成立最久的市值型ETF，指數邏輯歷經多空考驗，無人為選股錯誤並與時俱進，忠實反應台股與企業成長果實。統計0050成立以來截至9/8績效達2,367%，換算年化報酬率約為15%，等於資產投入不到5年即可翻倍成長，深受台股投資人青睞，推升其投資人數、定期定額戶數、定期定額金額居台股ETF之冠的龍頭地位。
而0056已是國人規劃被動現金流的重要選擇，其為市場唯一採「預測未來一年殖利率」指數選股邏輯，聚焦具獲利成長與配息潛力企業，在AI動能強勁、企業獲利配息創高下，推升0056股價創高、今年配息金額亦將改寫歷史新高的雙贏。
法人表示，市場短線仍受地緣政治與利率政策牽動，惟AI資本支出、雲端資料中心擴建及半導體、伺服器供應鏈需求延續，台股中長線成長趨勢未變。面對高檔震盪，投資人可回歸核心配置，以市值型ETF參與成長，搭配高股息ETF累積現金流。

items.title: 〈中華信評展望〉大宗商品寒冬仍未過 長春、台塑集團靠特化與分散性突圍
paras: 中華信評今(9)日出版2026年台灣企業信用焦點報告，在科技業一枝獨秀的背後，台灣石化、鋼鐵等大宗商品產業正面臨中國長期產能過剩、地緣政治與貿易壁壘等多重打擊，獲利將持續低於以往景氣低谷水準，受評鋼鐵業者的「借款對 EBITDA 比率」已升至 5 到 6 倍的高槓桿水準；傳統塑化產品價格與利潤率短期難見復甦，但長春與台塑集團展現出強大的營運韌性，顯示業者能否突圍高度取決於「特用化學品轉型」與「業務分散性」的能力。
台灣大宗商品傳統產業正面臨嚴峻的下行風險與信用壓力。中華信評最新報告指出，受中國長期結構性產能過剩、地緣政治衝突及全球貿易壁壘增加的多重打擊，石化、鋼鐵廠的獲利表現持續低於過去景氣循環低谷的水準。傳統塑化產品的價格與利潤率短期難見顯著回升，業者能否突圍高度取決於「垂直整合」與「業務分散」的能力，整體信用品質呈顯著 K 型分化。
中華信評資深高級分析師賴冠伃指出，大宗商品產業今年面臨多重風險。首先是地緣政治的不確定性，尤其是荷姆茲海峽運行受阻，推升了能源價格與通膨壓力；其次是各國政府為了因應中國產能外溢，紛紛樹立關稅與保護政策。雖然關稅保護了部分當地價格，但對於高度依賴出口的台灣鋼鐵與化學品業者來說，出口遭受相當大的衝擊。
在化學品方面，亞太區業者在消化完上半年低成本庫存後，下半年利潤空間將受到嚴重壓縮。賴冠伃分析，通用化學品受到產能過剩壓力的基調短期內難以解除，但企業表現已出現顯著差異。
其中，長春集團由於特用化學品(半導體產業)貢獻較高，受傳統原料外銷減少的影響較小，獲利表現維持良好。台塑集團方面，雖輕油裂解產能利用率仍低，但受惠於業務分散性，其電子材料(間接收益於 AI 產能排擠效應)與煉油業務獲利強勁，整體集團獲利與現金流表現充沛。
奇美因手握較多現金水位與財務緩衝，評等相對穩定；反觀台聚因乙烯體系生產壓力大，且下游太陽能光電供需失衡，獲利面臨較大考量。
至於鋼鐵業，賴冠伃表示，雖然東南亞新興國家的鋼鐵需求正在成長，但當地產能也在陸續增加，全球供需平衡短期難以大幅改善。台灣鋼鐵業者的借款對 EBITDA 壓力普遍高於亞洲同業，反映出對出口市場的高依賴度。例如龍頭中鋼受出口障礙影響，營運相對承受較大壓力；而華新麗華則因處分投資部位、歐洲不鏽鋼業務分散性及電線電纜業務上線，下行風險反而降低。
中華信評副首席分析師郭彥煒補充，從財務槓桿來看，金屬與採礦(鋼鐵)業受評客戶在 2026 至 2027 年的「借款對 EBITDA 中位數」仍維持在 5 到 6 倍的高水準，高於其他產業。雖然台灣整體企業獲利快速上升，但整體信用品質呈「K 型分化」，負面展望壓力幾乎全集中在傳統產業。
面對中國產能持續釋出所造成的供給過剩壓力，首席分析師許智清指出，傳統塑化產品的價格與利潤率短期內難見顯著回升，業者能否突圍將高度取決於「垂直整合」與「業務分散」的能力，僅單純依賴大宗通用化學品的業者，若缺乏向下游特化延伸的垂直整合能力或多角化布局，長期仍將面臨較大的財務與評等壓力。

items.title: VIX安靜得太詭異！美股像「沒繫安全帶飆車」 瑞銀示警一撞恐出大事
items.title_en: VIX Is Too Quietly Odd! U.S. Stocks Like a 'Seatbelt‑less Speeding Car'—UBS Warns a Crash Could Trigger Big Trouble
paras: 距離美國11月3日期中選舉僅剩兩個月，美股卻在政治與政策風險升高之際展現近乎「無所畏懼」的樂觀情緒。分析師警告，選擇權市場正浮現脆弱性與無懼情緒並存的危險組合，一旦意外事件引發震盪，市場可能缺乏足夠緩衝。
《路透》周三(9日)報導，儘管近期債市劇烈波動，美股仍徘徊歷史高點附近，波動率指標接近2026年低點，個股相關性也逼近歷史低位，顯示股票走勢較以往更加分散。分析師普遍不認為選舉結果本身會引發巨大市場反應，但9月至10月的選前階段可能充滿波動。
隨著投票日逼近，投資人焦點可能轉向國會控制權及其政策影響，包括美國是否出現分裂政府或執政基礎不穩等風險。歷史經驗顯示，期中選舉前的9月至10月原本就是美股容易震盪的時期，原因是市場告別夏季淡季後，投資人開始重新評估政治風險。

VIX未反映選舉風險 市場幾乎毫無戒心

Cantor Fitzgerald統計，自1930年以來的24個期中選舉年中，標普500指數有15次在9月至10月期間下跌至少5%。然而，目前波動率期貨幾乎看不出投資人的憂慮。
被視為市場恐慌指標的芝加哥選擇權交易所波動率指數(VIX)近期觸及今年新低，目前約為15，低於17.6的長期中位數。VIX期貨同樣保持平靜，反映投資人相信強勁企業獲利仍能支撐美股。
Tallbacken Capital Advisors執行長Michael Purves表示，VIX期貨曲線完全沒有納入期中選舉的風險溢價。
然而，未來兩個月的行事曆充滿潛在催化劑，包括通膨與就業數據、聯準會(Fed)利率會議，以及中國國家主席習近平9月底訪美，最後才是期中選舉。
《路透》與益普索(Ipsos) 民調顯示，在處理生活成本議題方面，選民對民主黨的信任度已明顯領先共和黨，對總統川普所屬政黨構成警訊。Evercore ISI股票及量化策略主管Julian Emanuel指出，若民主黨奪回眾議院，美國將從共和黨全面掌控白宮與國會，轉為分裂政府，市場不確定性可能升高；若參議院也翻盤，影響將進一步放大。

UBS模型亮紅燈 意外衝擊恐放大跌勢

市場過度無懼，加上投資部位擁擠、信用利差偏窄及避險需求有限，顯示投資人可能尚未為衝擊做好準備。瑞銀(UBS)利用機器學習預測未來一個月市場脆弱程度的「Turbu-lens」模型，8月底已升至最高壓力等級。
UBS美國股票衍生性商品研究主管Maxwell Grinacoff表示，該模型過去數周幾乎一直對「極端脆弱」狀態發出警報。他形容，現在的市場就像沒繫安全帶、以時速100英里在高速公路上駕駛卡丁車，或許能平安抵達終點，但一旦遭到撞擊，後果恐怕十分嚴重。
SimCorp亞太投資決策研究主管Olivier d’Assier也指出，現行市場機制完全沒有預期任何衝擊。儘管美股至今未受地緣政治緊張及債市重挫明顯影響，分析師擔憂市場已沒有多少犯錯空間。
部分投資人則認為，只要企業獲利與經濟成長維持強勁，選舉結果不至於破壞美股基本面。過去3年做空者屢遭虧損，也使投資人不願再次押注下跌。不過Emanuel認為，相較期中選舉帶來的風險，目前隱含波動率仍相當便宜，想為未來兩個月行情避險的投資人，可能正迎來成本較低的布局時機。
paras_en: With only two months left until the U.S. November 3 midterm elections, the stock market is showing almost fearless optimism despite rising political and policy risks. Analysts warn that the options market is displaying a dangerous mix of fragility and bravado, and a shock‑induced swing could leave the market without enough cushion.

Reuters reported on Wednesday the 9th that, despite recent bond‑market turbulence, U.S. equities are still hovering near historic highs, with volatility indicators close to their 2026 lows and stock correlations approaching historic lows, indicating a more dispersed rally. Analysts generally do not expect the election outcome itself to spark a massive market reaction, but the pre‑election period from September to October could be volatile.

As the voting day approaches, investors’ focus may shift to control of Congress and its policy impact, including risks of a divided government or an unstable governing base. History shows that September‑October, the months before a midterm, are traditionally shaky for U.S. stocks as the market exits the summer lull and investors reassess political risk.

Cantor Fitzgerald data show that in 15 of the 24 midterm election years since 1930, the S&P 500 fell at least 5% during September‑October. Yet current volatility futures show almost no sign of investor worry.

The Chicago Board Options Exchange’s VIX, the market’s fear gauge, has recently hit a new low for the year, sitting around 15, below its long‑term median of 17.6. VIX futures are equally calm, reflecting investors’ belief that strong corporate earnings can still support equities.
Michael Purves, CEO of Tallbacken Capital Advisors, said the VIX futures curve completely omits any risk premium for the midterm election.

However, the next two months are packed with potential catalysts, including inflation and employment data, the Fed’s rate meeting, Chinese President Xi Jinping’s late‑September visit to the United States, and finally the midterms themselves.

A Reuters‑Ipsos poll shows that on the cost‑of‑living issue, voters trust the Democratic Party significantly more than the Republicans, a warning sign for the party of former President Trump. Julian Emanuel, head of equities and quantitative strategy at Evercore ISI, noted that if Democrats retake the House, the U.S. would shift from a unified Republican control of the White House and Congress to a divided government, raising market uncertainty; a Senate flip would amplify the effect further.

UBS’s machine‑learning “Turbu‑lens” model, which predicts market fragility over the next month, hit its highest stress level at the end of August, flashing a red light for potential shock‑driven declines.

Maxwell Grinacoff, head of U.S. equity derivatives research at UBS, said the model has been issuing “extremely fragile” alerts for weeks. He likened the market to a go‑kart traveling at 100 mph on a highway without a seatbelt—maybe it can reach the finish line, but a collision would be disastrous.

Olivier d’Assier, head of Asia‑Pacific investment‑decision research at SimCorp, added that current market mechanisms do not anticipate any shock. Although U.S. stocks have so far escaped obvious impacts from geopolitical tension and bond‑market sell‑offs, analysts worry there is little room for error left.

Some investors argue that as long as corporate earnings and economic growth stay strong, the election outcome won’t damage the fundamentals of U.S. stocks. The past three years have seen short sellers repeatedly lose money, making investors reluctant to bet on a decline. Yet Emanuel believes that, compared with the risks of the midterms, implied volatility remains cheap, offering a low‑cost hedging opportunity for those looking to protect positions over the next two months.

items.title: 34年前「金融偷獵者」 大獲全勝 貝森特改換角色當莊家
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)本周展現出極具戰術性的貨幣政策風格，公開向外匯交易員喊話，大膽宣告「我現在就是莊家」。他強調自己對日本央行與日本政策制定者的行動擁有「資訊不對稱」優勢，並直接挑戰市場交易員敢不敢與他作對。
這種將主導權掌握在手的強硬作風，深深植根於他34年前協助索羅斯「擊潰英格蘭銀行」的頂尖避險基金經歷。
據《Fortune》記者Eva Roytburg報導，1992年時年僅29歲的貝森特洞察到英格蘭銀行的致命弱點：央行承諾將英鎊維持在歐洲匯率機制(ERM)的狹幅區間內，但透過升息來保衛匯率的做法，會嚴重打擊當時持有浮動利率房貸的英國屋主。
貝森特成功說服老闆索羅斯對英鎊發動大規模做空，最終迫使英國退出ERM，並為基金賺進10億美元利潤。Roytburg總結，貝森特從中汲取的關鍵教訓是：「當央行人為將貨幣維持在市場無法支持的水準時，市場最終將會獲勝」。
34年後，貝森特角色互換，從昔日的「金融偷獵者」變成了坐鎮局面的「金融護林員」。據報導，貝森特目前正與日本當局協調購買日元，且他多次暗示希望東京當局調升利率，而非僅依賴反覆干預。在他的警告與干預下，美元兌日元匯率已從2026年7月的163上方，一路回落至9月8日的153.96。
然而，這套強硬手法也在內部引發質疑；昔日索羅斯時期的同僚Stanley Druckenmiller公開指責他介入債券市場是個錯誤，而貝森特則反駁稱，擴大買回舊美債旨在冷卻美國公債市場的「發燒」現象。
據《路透》報導，日本央行預計在即將召開的會議上提高基準利率，這成為驗證貝森特威懾是否有效的即時測試。若日本當局順利升息，貝森特的豪賭就能成立；若日本猶豫不決，這位曾寫下狙擊央行教科書的掌權者，將親自驗證市場規律是否會反噬自己。

items.title: 特斯拉Cyber​​cab號稱「無需方向盤」——其實配備了隱藏式手動控制裝置
items.title_en: Tesla Cybercab Claims "No Steering Wheel"—But It Actually Has a Hidden Manual Control Device
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)無人駕駛計程車 Cybercab 近日於美國德州奧斯汀投入營運，此車款設計取消了傳統方向盤與煞車踏板。然而，乘客 Matthew Skrzypczak 在搭乘時發現，車內觸控螢幕意外切換至隱藏的「手動駕駛模式」，畫面上出現了虛擬搖桿(virtual joystick)介面。
根據 Skrzypczak 分享的畫面顯示，該控制介面將螢幕分為兩側，左側包含虛擬搖桿、車門控制、喇叭與求助按鈕，右側則顯示車外環景攝影畫面。當乘客嘗試操作時，螢幕出現「長按搖桿」及「上下滑動換檔」等操作提示，但車輛最終並未移動。
綜合外媒與業界分析，該功能為供特斯拉內部工程或維修人員使用的低速調度模式。此前也有民眾拍攝到工作人員透過螢幕手動微調車輛位置，以進行超級充電站充電。
這項隱藏介面的曝光，同時引發外界對監管合規與安全性的關注。美國國家公路交通安全管理局(NHTSA)已針對特斯拉無方向盤與踏板車輛的自我認證程序展開審查，涉及車輛約 1,000 輛。
針對車輛控制設計，科技媒體《Electrek》主編 Fred Lambert 指出，螢幕虛擬搖桿僅適合低速微調車位，當自動駕駛系統出現異常需要人工接管時，該介面並非完善的替代方案。
特斯拉董事長 Robin Denholm 曾表示，若未來法規強制要求，Cybercab 依然具備加裝實體方向盤與踏板的空間。《MotorTrend》記者 Miguel Cortina 則認為，自動駕駛服務在營運初期面臨技術磨合期屬正常現象，特斯拉若欲擴大營運規模，仍須加速完善相關系統與營運細節。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) has recently launched its driverless taxi Cybercab in Austin, Texas. The vehicle is designed without a traditional steering wheel or brake pedal. However, passenger Matthew Skrzypczak discovered that the interior touchscreen unexpectedly switched to a hidden "manual driving mode," displaying a virtual joystick interface.

According to the screenshots shared by Skrzypczak, the control interface splits the screen into two halves: the left side features a virtual joystick, door controls, horn and an emergency button, while the right side shows an external 360-degree camera view. When the passenger tried to operate it, prompts such as "press and hold joystick" and "swipe up/down to shift gears" appeared, but the vehicle never moved.

Combined reports from foreign media and industry analysts indicate that this feature is a low‑speed dispatch mode intended for Tesla’s internal engineers or maintenance staff. Earlier footage also showed staff manually fine‑tuning the vehicle’s position via the screen to connect to a Supercharger station.

The exposure of this hidden interface has sparked concerns about regulatory compliance and safety. The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has opened a review of Tesla’s self‑certification process for vehicles lacking steering wheels and pedals, covering roughly 1,000 units.

Regarding the vehicle’s control design, Fred Lambert, editor‑in‑chief of the tech outlet Electrek, noted that the screen’s virtual joystick is only suitable for low‑speed parking adjustments and is not a robust fallback when the autonomous system encounters an anomaly and requires human takeover.

Tesla chairperson Robin Denholm has said that if future regulations mandate it, the Cybercab can be retrofitted with a physical steering wheel and pedals. MotorTrend reporter Miguel Cortina considers the early technical hiccups in autonomous‑driving services to be normal, but stresses that Tesla must accelerate the refinement of its systems and operational details if it wants to scale up the service.

items.title: Google DeepMind用AI算出90億種DNA變異！AlphaGenome Atlas 1PB數據免費開源
items.title_en: Google DeepMind Uses AI to Compute 9 Billion DNA Variants! AlphaGenome Atlas 1 PB Data Free and Open‑Source
paras: Google(GOOGL-US) 旗下DeepMind推出由人工智慧（AI）驅動的基因組資料庫「AlphaGenome Atlas」，針對人類DNA中約90億種可能的單字母變異，預先計算其可能造成的分子生物學影響，並將相關結果整合成可搜尋的資料庫，免費開放學術研究使用。
AlphaGenome Atlas資料庫容量達1PB，規模超過Google先前AlphaFold資料庫的30倍，目標是讓研究人員能從全基因組尺度檢視各種單核苷酸變異（SNV）可能產生的影響，而不必逐一透過實驗測試。
人類基因組約有90億種可能的單字母突變，若完全依靠實驗逐一確認這些變異可能造成的生物學後果，實務上幾乎難以完成。
DeepMind此前推出AlphaGenome AI模型，可預測特定基因變異對各項生物過程的影響。
而此次推出AlphaGenome Atlas，則進一步將這項能力擴展至全基因組範圍，透過大規模預先計算，將各種可能的變異及其預測結果整合成完整資料集。
這項策略與AlphaFold資料庫的發展方向相似。當年AlphaFold將人類已知蛋白質3D結構的預測規模，從約19萬個擴大至超過2億個；AlphaGenome Atlas則試圖在基因調控層面建立相應的全基因組資源。
為了讓研究人員能在龐大的資料庫中快速找出值得進一步研究的變異，DeepMind也推出「AlphaGenome變異影響評分」（AlphaGenome Variant Impact，AVI）。
AVI評分整合AlphaGenome與蛋白質突變預測模型AlphaMissense的預測能力，將複雜的生物學預測結果轉化為單一數值。
其中一項重要特色，是同時涵蓋蛋白質編碼區與非編碼區。人類基因組僅約2%屬於蛋白質編碼區，其餘約98%為非編碼區，而非編碼區涉及基因活性的調控。AVI因此能同時評估兩類區域中的變異。
此外，評分結果也能進一步拆解可能涉及的分子機制，例如指出特定變異是否可能干擾RNA剪接或影響染色質可及性。
AlphaGenome Atlas同時建立基因組調控相關的序列資料庫，收錄超過2,500個經常出現的DNA短序列及其基因組位置，協助研究人員分析轉錄因子的結合位置與調控作用。
外部研究團隊已開始利用AlphaGenome Atlas進行實際研究。
在罕見疾病領域，Broad研究所研究團隊與GREGoR聯盟合作，利用AVI評分從大量基因變異中篩選可能具有致病性的突變，找出一個此前未受到重視的DNM1基因變異。研究結果顯示，該變異與癲癇性腦病高度相關。
AlphaGenome的預測進一步指出，這項變異可能產生錯誤的RNA剪接位點，使蛋白質出現異常延伸，後續實驗也驗證這項預測。
在複雜性狀研究方面，英國艾希特大學研究人員將AlphaGenome Atlas應用於英國生物樣本庫（UK Biobank）逾5.4萬名參與者的全基因組資料。
研究團隊將預測具有相似分子效應的罕見非編碼變異進行分組，進一步發現22%的非編碼區遺傳關聯，並找出可能影響與老化相關的PLA2G7與EGLN1等蛋白質水準的調控變異。
研究人員也分析數億個非編碼變異與身體質量指數（BMI）的關聯，聚焦於預測影響最大的前1%變異，最終鎖定19個關鍵遺傳區域。
此外，斯托斯醫學研究所（Stowers Institute for Medical Research）研究人員利用AlphaGenome Atlas的基序資料，分析不同轉錄因子的作用，進一步區分哪些轉錄因子主要影響DNA可及性，以及哪些轉錄因子能直接促進或抑制基因表現。
目前，全球學術研究人員已可使用AlphaGenome相關資源。
研究用途可透過DeepMind官方平台免費存取AlphaGenome；同時，AlphaGenome也已整合至Google Antigravity，作為科學研究相關功能使用。
此外，研究人員另可加入AlphaGenome使用者社群，交流相關應用與研究成果。
在商業應用方面，Google也正逐步擴大AlphaGenome的可用範圍。AlphaGenome基礎模型目前已透過GitHub及AlphaGenome API提供學術研究使用，未來商業用戶則可透過Google Cloud的Model Garden取得相關模型。
DeepMind同時提供完整技術論文與相關發布資訊，供研究人員進一步了解AlphaGenome Atlas的模型架構、資料建置方式及研究成果。
不過，AlphaGenome Atlas所提供的預測結果定位於科研用途，相關資訊僅供研究參考，並不適用於臨床診斷，也不構成醫療建議。
paras_en: Google (GOOGL‑US) subsidiary DeepMind has launched an AI‑driven genomic database called AlphaGenome Atlas, which pre‑computes the potential molecular‑biological impacts of roughly 9 billion possible single‑letter variants in human DNA and integrates the results into a searchable repository that is freely available for academic research.

The AlphaGenome Atlas database occupies 1 petabyte, more than 30 times the size of Google’s earlier AlphaFold database, and is intended to let researchers examine the possible effects of all single‑nucleotide variants (SNVs) at a whole‑genome scale without having to test each one experimentally.
The human genome contains about 9 billion conceivable single‑letter mutations; confirming the biological consequences of each experimentally would be practically impossible.
DeepMind previously released the AlphaGenome AI model, which can predict how specific gene variants affect various biological processes.
The new AlphaGenome Atlas extends that capability to the entire genome, performing massive pre‑computations and assembling all possible variants and their predicted outcomes into a complete dataset.

This strategy mirrors the development path of the AlphaFold database, which expanded predicted human protein 3D structures from roughly 190 k to over 200 million; AlphaGenome Atlas aims to build a comparable whole‑genome resource for gene regulation.
To help researchers quickly pinpoint variants worth further study within the massive database, DeepMind also introduced the AlphaGenome Variant Impact (AVI) score.
The AVI score combines AlphaGenome’s predictions with those of the protein‑mutation model AlphaMissense, converting complex biological forecasts into a single numeric value.

A key feature is that it covers both coding and non‑coding regions. Only about 2 % of the human genome is protein‑coding, while the remaining ~98 % is non‑coding and involved in regulatory control, so AVI can assess variants in both types of regions.
The score can also be broken down to suggest possible molecular mechanisms, such as indicating whether a variant might disrupt RNA splicing or affect chromatin accessibility.

AlphaGenome Atlas also builds a regulatory‑sequence database, cataloguing more than 2,500 frequently occurring DNA short motifs and their genomic locations to aid analysis of transcription‑factor binding sites and regulatory effects.
External research teams have already begun using AlphaGenome Atlas for real‑world studies.

In rare‑disease research, a Broad Institute team collaborating with the GREGoR consortium used AVI scores to filter thousands of gene variants and identified a previously overlooked DNM1 mutation that is strongly associated with epileptic encephalopathy.
AlphaGenome’s prediction further indicated that this mutation could create an aberrant RNA‑splicing site, leading to an abnormally extended protein, a hypothesis later confirmed experimentally.
For complex‑trait studies, researchers at the University of Exeter applied AlphaGenome Atlas to whole‑genome data from over 54,000 UK Biobank participants.

The team grouped rare non‑coding variants with similar predicted molecular effects, uncovering that 22 % of non‑coding genetic associations involve regulatory variants that may influence protein levels of aging‑related genes such as PLA2G7 and EGLN1.

They also examined hundreds of millions of non‑coding variants for links to body‑mass index (BMI), focusing on the top 1 % of variants with the greatest predicted impact and ultimately pinpointing 19 key genetic loci.

Additionally, scientists at the Stowers Institute for Medical Research used AlphaGenome Atlas motif data to dissect the actions of different transcription factors, distinguishing those that primarily affect DNA accessibility from those that directly promote or repress gene expression.
Currently, academic researchers worldwide can access AlphaGenome resources.
Research use is free via DeepMind’s official platform, and AlphaGenome has also been integrated into Google Antigravity for scientific‑research‑related functions.
Researchers may also join the AlphaGenome user community to share applications and findings.

In the commercial arena, Google is gradually expanding AlphaGenome’s availability; the core model is already offered through GitHub and an AlphaGenome API for academic work, with future commercial access planned via Google Cloud’s Model Garden.
DeepMind provides full technical papers and release notes so investigators can learn about AlphaGenome Atlas’s model architecture, data construction methods, and results.
However, the predictions supplied by AlphaGenome Atlas are intended solely for research purposes, are not suitable for clinical diagnosis, and do not constitute medical advice.

items.title: OpenAI推出ChatGPT Images 2.5：生成速度提升50% 主打精準局部修圖
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Images 2.5: Generation Speed Up 50% and Focuses on Precise Local Editing
paras: OpenAI 周二(8日)正式推出新一代圖像生成模型「ChatGPT Images 2.5」，全面開放給 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 及 Codex 使用者。
相較於上一代 Images 2.0，新模型的生成延遲最多降低了 50%，並顯著提升光影自然度與紋理細節。目前使用者每週透過 ChatGPT Images 及 API 生成的圖片已超過 30 億張。
此次升級的核心在於將 AI 生圖從「一次性出圖」推進至可連續微調的生產工作流。
全新功能包含：可在圖片上直接標註評論進行局部修改；新增「Sketch」手繪功能，輸入「@Sketch」即可將草圖轉化為完整影像；以及提供海報與商品圖範本。面向開發者，OpenAI 同步發布了 GPT-Image-2.5 Flare（主打高速度）與 Sunburst（主打精細控制）兩款 API 模型，標準定價為前代兩倍。
針對產品理念，OpenAI 圖像產品負責人 Adele Li 向外媒 Axios 表示，Sketch 與範本設計是為了讓使用者更深入參與創作，而非成為被動接受者，藉此打破「單一 AI 審美」並展現個人特色。
各大媒體與合作夥伴也針對新模型提出評價：
TechRadar 經過 24 小時測試後指出，雖然 Images 2.5 未達跨代等級的突破，但局部編輯與 Sketch 等實用功能已足以改變日常使用習慣。
Axios 實測發現，新模型在跨風格轉換時能更好保留人物與寵物的特徵，使 AI 生圖與傳統設計工具的界線更加模糊，同時也提醒業界仍需注意訓練資料授權等倫理問題。
API 合作夥伴 Manus 評估表示，Flare 的生成速度為前代的 2 至 4 倍，且透明背景處理能力顯著提升。
paras_en: OpenAI officially launched the next‑generation image generation model “ChatGPT Images 2.5” on Tuesday (the 8th), making it fully available to ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and Codex users.

Compared with the previous generation Images 2.0, the new model reduces generation latency by up to 50% and markedly improves natural lighting and texture detail. So far users have generated more than 3 billion images per week through ChatGPT Images and the API.
The upgrade’s core is moving AI‑generated images from a “one‑shot” output to a continuously fine‑tunable production workflow.

New features include the ability to annotate comments directly on an image for local edits; a new “Sketch” drawing function that turns a hand‑drawn sketch (triggered with “@Sketch”) into a full‑fledged image; and ready‑made poster and product‑image templates. For developers, OpenAI also released two API models—GPT‑Image‑2.5 Flare (optimized for speed) and Sunburst (optimized for fine‑grained control)—priced at twice the rate of the previous generation.

Regarding the product philosophy, Adele Li, head of OpenAI’s image products, told Axios that Sketch and the template designs are meant to let users take a more active role in creation rather than be passive recipients, breaking the “single AI aesthetic” and showcasing personal style.
Major media outlets and partners have weighed in on the new model:
TechRadar, after 24 hours of testing, noted that while Images 2.5 does not represent a generational breakthrough, its local‑editing and Sketch utilities are enough to change everyday usage habits.

Axios’s hands‑on testing found that the new model preserves human and pet features better during cross‑style transfers, blurring the line between AI‑generated images and traditional design tools, while also reminding the industry to remain vigilant about training‑data licensing and ethics issues.
API partner Manus assessed that Flare’s generation speed is 2‑to‑4 times faster than the previous version and that its handling of transparent backgrounds has improved significantly.

items.title: OpenAI深化與三星戰略合作 布局下一代晶片與企業級AI服務
items.title_en: OpenAI Deepens Strategic Partnership with Samsung, Positioning Next‑Generation Chips and Enterprise AI Services
paras: OpenAI 南韓區總經理 Harrison Kim 周三(9日)於首爾記者會上表示，公司正深化與三星電子在下一代晶片開發(共同生產與研究)及企業級 AI 服務上的合作，並稱三星是其在晶片領域發展最先進的合作夥伴之一。對此，三星電子則回應無法確認與客戶相關的資訊。
OpenAI 正積極發展自研晶片，先前於 6 月公布首款與博通(AVGO-US)聯合設計的 AI 推理晶片「Jalapeno」，並由台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)負責製造。由於更先進的運算需要更高速複雜的晶片，三星與 SK 海力士(SKHY-US)去年已簽署意向書，為 OpenAI 的 Stargate 資料中心計畫供應記憶體晶片。
在企業應用方面，三星是全球大規模部署 ChatGPT 的企業之一，員工廣泛應用於研發、行銷與銷售等業務。
此外，南韓市場發展極為迅速，截至 8 月底，南韓企業的 ChatGPT Enterprise 用戶數年增約 28 倍，更是去年底美國以外付費訂戶最多的國家。OpenAI 預期，在 9 月 4 日推出最新模型 GPT-6 Astra 後，企業採納速度將進一步加速。
paras_en: OpenAI’s South Korea regional manager Harrison Kim said on Wednesday (the 9th) at a press conference in Seoul that the company is deepening its collaboration with Samsung Electronics on the development (joint production and research) of next‑generation chips and enterprise‑grade AI services, calling Samsung one of its most advanced partners in the chip domain. Samsung responded that it could not confirm information related to the customer.

OpenAI is actively developing its own chips; in June it announced its first AI inference chip, “Jalapeno,” co‑designed with Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and manufactured by TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US). Because more advanced computing requires faster, more complex chips, Samsung and SK Hynix (SKHY‑US) signed a letter of intent last year to supply memory chips for OpenAI’s Stargate data‑center project.

In the enterprise arena, Samsung is one of the companies worldwide that has deployed ChatGPT at large scale, with employees widely using it for research and development, marketing, and sales activities.

South Korea’s market is growing extremely fast; by the end of August, the number of ChatGPT Enterprise users in Korean companies had increased roughly 28‑fold year‑over‑year, making the country the largest market outside the United States for paid subscriptions at the end of last year. OpenAI expects that the rollout of its latest model, GPT‑6 Astra, on September 4 will further accelerate corporate adoption.

items.title: AI投資拉動美國經濟？摩根士丹利：真正AI新增貢獻約0.42個百分點
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資已成為美國經濟成長的重要支柱，但企業投入的AI資金，並不等同於美國GDP的新增產出，更不能直接視為AI帶來的實際生產力。摩根士丹利最新分析指出，拆解投資規模與實際經濟貢獻後，可以發現目前AI熱潮對美國經濟的支撐仍主要來自基礎建設，而非AI應用全面普及。
摩根士丹利截至9月8日的估算顯示，2025年至2026年上半年，廣義AI相關投資平均貢獻美國實質GDP增長約0.61個百分點；不過，若進一步排除即使沒有AI熱潮也可能發生的正常投資，真正由AI熱潮帶動的新增投資貢獻約0.42個百分點。
這兩項數據並非代表AI占美國GDP的比例，而是AI相關投資對GDP增長率的貢獻。廣義指標涵蓋資料中心、電腦設備、通訊設備、電力及軟體等投資，其中部分支出即使沒有生成式AI也可能發生，因此不能全部歸因於AI。

AI投資仍以基礎建設為主

從AI新增投資的結構來看，目前市場對資料中心、伺服器及相關基礎設施的投入，仍遠高於軟體應用。
摩根士丹利估算，2026年上半年AI基礎建設投資對實質GDP增長貢獻約0.36個百分點，軟體相關投資則貢獻約0.18個百分點，前者約為後者的兩倍。
以名目當期年化金額計算，摩根士丹利估計AI獨有投資約4500億美元，其中約3900億美元來自基礎建設，軟體約600億美元。不過，年化數字代表按照目前支出速度折算一年，並非半年內實際投入4500億美元。
在AI基礎建設中，電腦及周邊設備約占60%至70%，顯示運算設備仍是主要支出項目；資料中心建築與電力設施雖然占比相對較低，卻是AI運算設備能否投入運作的重要環節。

企業砸錢不等於美國GDP同步增加

摩根士丹利指出，解讀AI資本支出時，還必須考慮進口因素。大型雲端業者的資本支出可能用於全球市場，但美國GDP只計算境內生產活動。
例如，企業購買海外製造的伺服器，雖然會反映在企業投資支出中，但進口部分並不會直接形成美國國內新增產出。因此，AI資本支出必須扣除相關進口內容後，才能更接近其對美國GDP的實際貢獻。
近期AI投資淨貢獻增加，也部分受到進口抵消幅度下降的影響。摩根士丹利指出，2025年上半年進口對投資的抵消接近0.4個百分點，到2026年上半年已降至0.2個百分點以下。
這代表GDP貢獻增加，不一定完全代表AI建設速度同步加快，也可能受到進口結構及採購時點變化影響。

AI熱潮下一階段　關鍵在應用能否帶來回報

摩根士丹利認為，目前AI經濟仍處於大量建設基礎設施的階段。軟體投資雖然持續增加，但企業增加AI軟體及研發支出，並不能直接證明AI已全面改變企業工作流程或帶來成本下降。
因此，判斷AI熱潮能否持續，不能只看大型科技企業的資本支出，而要進一步觀察AI應用是否開始轉化為實際生產力與經營成果，包括企業付費使用、續約、工作流程改變及服務成本下降等指標。
換言之，目前AI已確實對美國經濟成長產生影響，但真正的考驗才剛開始：當資料中心、伺服器與電力等基礎建設完成後，AI能否進一步轉化為企業生產力與實際經濟回報，將決定這波AI投資熱潮能否延續。

items.title: 貝森特的債券回購構想 讓華爾街美債交易員不安
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)即將公布他針對美債回購的初步計畫，闡明將多大程度上利用擴大後的回購項目，來抑制美債殖利率。然而，這一舉措已讓華爾街交易商感到不安。
市場焦慮的核心在於其政策風格的轉變、缺乏明確指引，以及政策金額設定上的兩難局面。

打破「可預測」傳統 掀主動干預疑慮

貝森特在8月19日於定期例行日程之外突然宣佈，將原定20億美元的買回規模「至少翻倍」，震驚市場。這項舉動打破了財政部長期遵循「定期且可預測」的債務管理原則，引發市場討論其是否正轉向更具主動干預色彩的管理風格。
儘管初期的宣告曾帶動長天期債券價格反彈，但近幾周殖利率又因全球央行緊縮與財政赤字焦慮而再次走高，特別是攸關房貸利率的10年期公債殖利率，已高於上月水準。

買回規模陷入兩難 專家直言策略倉促

貝森特形容買回計畫旨在冷卻市場「升溫的高燒」，但他多次拒絕透露9月10日的具體金額，僅拉高了市場對規模將超過40億美元的預期。市場分析，若買回金額僅有40億美元，恐引發投資人失望並加劇拋售壓力
；但若金額衝高，也可能面臨副作用。
Wrightson ICAP 高級經濟學家Lou Crandall在給客戶的報告中直言：「大幅增加買回金額，等於承認財政部當初根本沒想清楚8月19日倉促做出的決定」。Crandall認為50億至60億美元是合理的起點。
根據 Wrightson 的試算，若將每次買回金額提高至60億美元，20年期以上公債的每季淨發行量將減少約27%；若拉高至100億美元上限，供給更將大幅砍半(約55%)。

缺乏明確路線圖 資金來源未明

除了規模未知，資金來源同樣尚未明朗，市場推測可能發行更多短期國庫券或動用庫存現金。摩根士丹利策略師警告，受限於資金約束，每場操作的上限約落在100億美元。
巴克萊(Barclays)策略師Anshul Pradhan與Demi Hu則指出，財政部甚至可能採取開放式指引(如「每場至少40億美元」)，雖然能保留彈性，卻會讓市場失去明確的路線圖。

關鍵標售前夕 交易員聚焦交換利差

這項消息發布時間緊鄰10年期公債標售前數小時，隔日更有30年期公債標售，大大放大了即時影響。
彭博總體策略師Brendan Fagan分析，交易員將即時消化購買規模，超出預期的操作雖可能暫時推低長天期殖利率，但該規模相對於龐大的美債市場仍偏小；相比於絕對殖利率，30年期交換利差(swap spreads)將能更清晰反映市場對此決策的最終評價。

items.title: VIX安靜得太詭異！美股像「沒繫安全帶飆車」 瑞銀示警一撞恐出大事
items.title_en: VIX Is Too Quietly Odd! U.S. Stocks Like a 'Seatbelt‑less Speeding Car'—UBS Warns a Crash Could Trigger Big Trouble
paras: 距離美國11月3日期中選舉僅剩兩個月，美股卻在政治與政策風險升高之際展現近乎「無所畏懼」的樂觀情緒。分析師警告，選擇權市場正浮現脆弱性與無懼情緒並存的危險組合，一旦意外事件引發震盪，市場可能缺乏足夠緩衝。
《路透》周三(9日)報導，儘管近期債市劇烈波動，美股仍徘徊歷史高點附近，波動率指標接近2026年低點，個股相關性也逼近歷史低位，顯示股票走勢較以往更加分散。分析師普遍不認為選舉結果本身會引發巨大市場反應，但9月至10月的選前階段可能充滿波動。
隨著投票日逼近，投資人焦點可能轉向國會控制權及其政策影響，包括美國是否出現分裂政府或執政基礎不穩等風險。歷史經驗顯示，期中選舉前的9月至10月原本就是美股容易震盪的時期，原因是市場告別夏季淡季後，投資人開始重新評估政治風險。

VIX未反映選舉風險 市場幾乎毫無戒心

Cantor Fitzgerald統計，自1930年以來的24個期中選舉年中，標普500指數有15次在9月至10月期間下跌至少5%。然而，目前波動率期貨幾乎看不出投資人的憂慮。
被視為市場恐慌指標的芝加哥選擇權交易所波動率指數(VIX)近期觸及今年新低，目前約為15，低於17.6的長期中位數。VIX期貨同樣保持平靜，反映投資人相信強勁企業獲利仍能支撐美股。
Tallbacken Capital Advisors執行長Michael Purves表示，VIX期貨曲線完全沒有納入期中選舉的風險溢價。
然而，未來兩個月的行事曆充滿潛在催化劑，包括通膨與就業數據、聯準會(Fed)利率會議，以及中國國家主席習近平9月底訪美，最後才是期中選舉。
《路透》與益普索(Ipsos) 民調顯示，在處理生活成本議題方面，選民對民主黨的信任度已明顯領先共和黨，對總統川普所屬政黨構成警訊。Evercore ISI股票及量化策略主管Julian Emanuel指出，若民主黨奪回眾議院，美國將從共和黨全面掌控白宮與國會，轉為分裂政府，市場不確定性可能升高；若參議院也翻盤，影響將進一步放大。

UBS模型亮紅燈 意外衝擊恐放大跌勢

市場過度無懼，加上投資部位擁擠、信用利差偏窄及避險需求有限，顯示投資人可能尚未為衝擊做好準備。瑞銀(UBS)利用機器學習預測未來一個月市場脆弱程度的「Turbu-lens」模型，8月底已升至最高壓力等級。
UBS美國股票衍生性商品研究主管Maxwell Grinacoff表示，該模型過去數周幾乎一直對「極端脆弱」狀態發出警報。他形容，現在的市場就像沒繫安全帶、以時速100英里在高速公路上駕駛卡丁車，或許能平安抵達終點，但一旦遭到撞擊，後果恐怕十分嚴重。
SimCorp亞太投資決策研究主管Olivier d’Assier也指出，現行市場機制完全沒有預期任何衝擊。儘管美股至今未受地緣政治緊張及債市重挫明顯影響，分析師擔憂市場已沒有多少犯錯空間。
部分投資人則認為，只要企業獲利與經濟成長維持強勁，選舉結果不至於破壞美股基本面。過去3年做空者屢遭虧損，也使投資人不願再次押注下跌。不過Emanuel認為，相較期中選舉帶來的風險，目前隱含波動率仍相當便宜，想為未來兩個月行情避險的投資人，可能正迎來成本較低的布局時機。
paras_en: With only two months left until the U.S. November 3 midterm elections, the stock market is showing almost fearless optimism despite rising political and policy risks. Analysts warn that the options market is displaying a dangerous mix of fragility and bravado, and a shock‑induced swing could leave the market without enough cushion.

Reuters reported on Wednesday the 9th that, despite recent bond‑market turbulence, U.S. equities are still hovering near historic highs, with volatility indicators close to their 2026 lows and stock correlations approaching historic lows, indicating a more dispersed rally. Analysts generally do not expect the election outcome itself to spark a massive market reaction, but the pre‑election period from September to October could be volatile.

As the voting day approaches, investors’ focus may shift to control of Congress and its policy impact, including risks of a divided government or an unstable governing base. History shows that September‑October, the months before a midterm, are traditionally shaky for U.S. stocks as the market exits the summer lull and investors reassess political risk.

Cantor Fitzgerald data show that in 15 of the 24 midterm election years since 1930, the S&P 500 fell at least 5% during September‑October. Yet current volatility futures show almost no sign of investor worry.

The Chicago Board Options Exchange’s VIX, the market’s fear gauge, has recently hit a new low for the year, sitting around 15, below its long‑term median of 17.6. VIX futures are equally calm, reflecting investors’ belief that strong corporate earnings can still support equities.
Michael Purves, CEO of Tallbacken Capital Advisors, said the VIX futures curve completely omits any risk premium for the midterm election.

However, the next two months are packed with potential catalysts, including inflation and employment data, the Fed’s rate meeting, Chinese President Xi Jinping’s late‑September visit to the United States, and finally the midterms themselves.

A Reuters‑Ipsos poll shows that on the cost‑of‑living issue, voters trust the Democratic Party significantly more than the Republicans, a warning sign for the party of former President Trump. Julian Emanuel, head of equities and quantitative strategy at Evercore ISI, noted that if Democrats retake the House, the U.S. would shift from a unified Republican control of the White House and Congress to a divided government, raising market uncertainty; a Senate flip would amplify the effect further.

UBS’s machine‑learning “Turbu‑lens” model, which predicts market fragility over the next month, hit its highest stress level at the end of August, flashing a red light for potential shock‑driven declines.

Maxwell Grinacoff, head of U.S. equity derivatives research at UBS, said the model has been issuing “extremely fragile” alerts for weeks. He likened the market to a go‑kart traveling at 100 mph on a highway without a seatbelt—maybe it can reach the finish line, but a collision would be disastrous.

Olivier d’Assier, head of Asia‑Pacific investment‑decision research at SimCorp, added that current market mechanisms do not anticipate any shock. Although U.S. stocks have so far escaped obvious impacts from geopolitical tension and bond‑market sell‑offs, analysts worry there is little room for error left.

Some investors argue that as long as corporate earnings and economic growth stay strong, the election outcome won’t damage the fundamentals of U.S. stocks. The past three years have seen short sellers repeatedly lose money, making investors reluctant to bet on a decline. Yet Emanuel believes that, compared with the risks of the midterms, implied volatility remains cheap, offering a low‑cost hedging opportunity for those looking to protect positions over the next two months.

items.title: SK海力士Q4擬砸40兆韓元回購？標普：AI記憶體需求強勁、股東回報再升級
items.title_en: SK Hynix May Announce Up to 40 Trillion Won Buyback in Q4? S&P: AI Memory Demand Strong, Shareholder Returns Upgraded
paras: 標普全球市場情報（S&P Global Market Intelligence）最新預測指出，受人工智慧（AI）帶動記憶體晶片需求強勁、景氣持續升溫的支撐，SK海力士(000660KS) 可能在今年第4季宣布新一輪股票回購計畫，規模預估介於20兆至40兆韓元（約280億美元）。
標普認為，SK海力士近期強化股東回報的作法，正逐漸從一次性的市場刺激措施，轉向更制度化、常態化的回饋機制。
SK海力士先前已執行一項規模達40兆韓元的股票回購及註銷計畫，並承諾將超過50%的自由現金流（FCF）用於回饋股東。
市場預期，SK海力士若再次啟動大規模庫藏股回購，在強勁現金流支撐下，仍有能力維持可觀的股息發放，可能進一步強化南韓政府推動的「企業價值提升」（Value-up）政策，也為韓股股東回報行情增添動能。
南韓政府近年積極推動「企業價值提升」計畫，希望透過庫藏股註銷、提高股息等措施改善企業治理與股東回報，以降低南韓資本市場長期存在的「南韓折價」。
三星電子(005930KS) 此前已註銷逾8,700萬股庫藏股，並推出大規模股息計畫，被視為響應政策方向的代表性案例。
標普亞太股票股息預測主管Mohammad Hassan接受採訪時表示，SK海力士下一輪回購規模至少可能達20兆韓元，不排除再次達到40兆韓元的上限。
相關預期帶動SK海力士ADR(SKHY-US) 股價走強，週二（8日）大漲逾6%，收在187.99美元；週三（9日）韓股開盤後，SK海力士股價一度上漲5%。
Hassan同時預期，今年第4季可能有更多南韓上市企業宣布股票回購計畫。他指出，愈來愈多企業可能跟進，因為這將逐步為上市公司建立更高的投資人回報標準。
他認為，三星電子創紀錄的股息政策，加上SK海力士逐步常態化的股票回購，可能為南韓企業的市值管理與公司治理建立新的標準，並對整體南韓股市帶來正面影響。
paras_en: S&P Global Market Intelligence’s latest forecast says that, driven by strong AI‑fueled demand for memory chips and a warming economy, SK Hynix (000660.KS) could announce a new share‑repurchase program in the fourth quarter of this year, sized at roughly 20‑40 trillion won (about $28 billion).
S&P believes that SK Hynix’s recent moves to boost shareholder returns are shifting from one‑off market‑stimulus actions toward a more institutionalized, regularised feedback mechanism.
SK Hynix has previously carried out a share‑repurchase and cancellation program worth 40 trillion won and pledged to use more than 50 % of its free cash flow for shareholder returns.

The market expects that if SK Hynix launches another large‑scale buyback, its strong cash flow will still allow it to maintain sizable dividend payouts, potentially reinforcing the South Korean government’s “Value‑up” corporate‑value‑enhancement policy and adding momentum to the Korean‑stock shareholder‑return rally.

In recent years the South Korean government has been actively promoting a “Value‑up” agenda, aiming to improve corporate governance and shareholder returns through share cancellations, higher dividends and other measures to reduce the long‑standing “Korea discount” in its capital markets.
Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) has already cancelled more than 87 million treasury shares and launched a massive dividend program, seen as a flagship example of aligning with the policy direction.

Mohammad Hassan, head of Asia‑Pacific dividend forecasting at S&P, told reporters that SK Hynix’s next buyback could be at least 20 trillion won, and it would not be surprising if it reaches the 40 trillion‑won ceiling again.

The expectations helped lift SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) shares, which jumped more than 6 % on Tuesday the 8th to close at $187.99, and on Wednesday the 9th the Korean‑stock price rose as much as 5 % after the market opened.

Hassan also forecast that more South Korean listed companies may announce share‑repurchase plans in Q4, noting that an increasing number of firms are likely to follow suit as this gradually sets higher investor‑return standards for listed companies.

He believes that Samsung’s record‑setting dividend policy, combined with SK Hynix’s move toward a regularised buyback regime, could establish new benchmarks for market‑cap management and corporate governance among Korean firms and have a positive impact on the overall South Korean stock market.

items.title: 34年前「金融偷獵者」 大獲全勝 貝森特改換角色當莊家
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)本周展現出極具戰術性的貨幣政策風格，公開向外匯交易員喊話，大膽宣告「我現在就是莊家」。他強調自己對日本央行與日本政策制定者的行動擁有「資訊不對稱」優勢，並直接挑戰市場交易員敢不敢與他作對。
這種將主導權掌握在手的強硬作風，深深植根於他34年前協助索羅斯「擊潰英格蘭銀行」的頂尖避險基金經歷。
據《Fortune》記者Eva Roytburg報導，1992年時年僅29歲的貝森特洞察到英格蘭銀行的致命弱點：央行承諾將英鎊維持在歐洲匯率機制(ERM)的狹幅區間內，但透過升息來保衛匯率的做法，會嚴重打擊當時持有浮動利率房貸的英國屋主。
貝森特成功說服老闆索羅斯對英鎊發動大規模做空，最終迫使英國退出ERM，並為基金賺進10億美元利潤。Roytburg總結，貝森特從中汲取的關鍵教訓是：「當央行人為將貨幣維持在市場無法支持的水準時，市場最終將會獲勝」。
34年後，貝森特角色互換，從昔日的「金融偷獵者」變成了坐鎮局面的「金融護林員」。據報導，貝森特目前正與日本當局協調購買日元，且他多次暗示希望東京當局調升利率，而非僅依賴反覆干預。在他的警告與干預下，美元兌日元匯率已從2026年7月的163上方，一路回落至9月8日的153.96。
然而，這套強硬手法也在內部引發質疑；昔日索羅斯時期的同僚Stanley Druckenmiller公開指責他介入債券市場是個錯誤，而貝森特則反駁稱，擴大買回舊美債旨在冷卻美國公債市場的「發燒」現象。
據《路透》報導，日本央行預計在即將召開的會議上提高基準利率，這成為驗證貝森特威懾是否有效的即時測試。若日本當局順利升息，貝森特的豪賭就能成立；若日本猶豫不決，這位曾寫下狙擊央行教科書的掌權者，將親自驗證市場規律是否會反噬自己。

items.title: G10貨幣黑馬恐失色！主要央行升息潮壓頂 英鎊漲勢面臨回檔危機
items.title_en: G10 Currency Dark Horse May Lose Its Luster! Central Bank Rate‑Hike Wave Peaks, Pound’s Rise Faces Pull‑Back Risk
paras: 儘管英國政府再次更迭、地緣政治帶來衝擊，英鎊大致上未受影響，今年來表現優於許多主要貨幣，然而，近期這股動能逐漸減弱，而且疲弱走勢恐怕將進一步加劇。
今年以來，英鎊兌歐元升值約1.6%，兌瑞士法郎升值2.8%，兌瑞典克朗升值4.9%，兌加拿大元升值1%。同期間，英鎊兌美元大致持平，兌日元則貶值1.3%。
英國前首相施凱爾(Keir Starmer)7月20日辭職後，英國迎接10年內第七位上台的領導人，市場密切關注新政府是否會遵守前財政大臣Rachel Reeves強調的「財政規則」。
在同樣來自中間偏左工黨的資深政治人物柏南(Andy Burnham)上台後，英國長期借貸成本走高，但這與全球政府公債遭拋售的走勢同步。

英國長期借貸成本創1998年以來最高

金融服務公司Ebury市場策略主管Matthew Ryan表示，過去三個月以來，英鎊是G10富裕國家貨幣中「意外強勢的貨幣」，主要歸因於英國經濟韌性超乎預期。
英國第2季國內生產毛額(GDP)成長0.4%，第1季則成長0.6%，在已開發經濟體中表現數一數二強勁。晴朗天氣以及FIFA世界盃帶來的熱潮提振消費支出，而儘管地緣政治局勢動盪，企業活動仍展現超乎預期的韌性。
Rabobank資深外匯策略師Jane Foley表示，4月伊朗衝突爆發初期，，由於市場預期英國央行(BOE)將為因應通膨疑慮而升息，成為當時支撐英鎊的力量。
英國易受油價及天然氣價格上漲的影響，而這兩種天然資源今年均大幅上漲，導致整體通膨率升抵近3%水準。

英鎊弱勢可能加劇？

儘管物價壓力再度升溫，英國央行迄今仍將基準利率維持在3.75%。
目前市場定價顯示，英國9月17日會議升息的機率偏低。相較之下，市場高度預期歐洲央行(ECB)本周將升息，對聯準會(Fed)本月17日升息的預期也日益升高。
Rabobank的Foley指出，在柏南政府10月28日將公布首份年度預算案，市場正為此感到不安之際，英國央行下周若釋出鴿派訊息，將「進一步讓英鎊暴露在風險之中」。
英國新任財政大臣John Healey周一在演講中表示，他仍將致力於維持財政紀律，同時希望讓經濟成長更平均分布於英國各地，而非集中在經濟核心倫敦。
摩根大通英國經濟學家Allan Monks表示，他的談話顯示，在借貸成本上揚的背景下，政府對稅收及支出政策的調整將採取審慎態度。預算案可能繼續聚焦於地方分權、提高公共服務的政府控制，以及與民間部門建立更多合作關係，但對整體經濟展望的改變有限。
Ebury的Ryan表示，這份預算案具有高度政治風險，可能包含「提高附加稅率以及增加發債」，以支應柏南政府的支出計畫。
他表示，相關措施可能包括調整房產購買稅及地方政府稅、引進「豪宅稅」，以及收緊退休金與個人投資帳戶的稅務優惠。他補充，若市場認為相關措施可能抑制經濟成長並壓縮民間部門，同時又需要增加借款，市場將對此感到不安。
paras_en: Despite a reshuffled UK government and geopolitical shocks, the pound has largely been unaffected and has outperformed many major currencies this year, but its momentum has recently been waning and a weak trend could worsen further.

Since the start of the year the pound has appreciated about 1.6% against the euro, 2.8% against the Swiss franc, 4.9% against the Swedish krona and 1% against the Canadian dollar. Over the same period it has been roughly flat versus the US dollar and down 1.3% versus the Japanese yen.

After former Prime Minister Keir Starmer resigned on July 20, the UK welcomed its seventh leader in ten years, and markets are watching closely whether the new administration will adhere to the “fiscal rules” emphasized by former finance minister Rachel Reeves.
Following the ascent of senior Labour figure Andy Burnham, long‑term borrowing costs in the UK have risen, a trend that mirrors the global sell‑off of sovereign bonds.

Long‑term borrowing costs in the UK have hit their highest level since 1998. Matthew Ryan, head of market strategy at financial‑services firm Ebury, said the pound has been the “surprisingly strong currency” among G10 affluent‑nation currencies over the past three months, mainly because the UK economy’s resilience has exceeded expectations.

UK GDP grew 0.4% in Q2 after a 0.6% gain in Q1, making it one of the strongest performers among developed economies. Sunny weather and the FIFA World Cup hype boosted consumer spending, and despite geopolitical turbulence, business activity showed unexpectedly robust resilience.

Rabobank senior FX strategist Jane Foley noted that when the Iran conflict erupted in early April, markets expected the Bank of England to raise rates to combat inflation, which at the time supported the pound.
The UK is vulnerable to rising oil and natural‑gas prices, both of which have surged sharply this year, pushing overall inflation close to the 3% level.
Could a weaker pound exacerbate the situation? Although price pressures have heated up again, the Bank of England has kept its policy rate at 3.75% so far.

Current market pricing shows a low probability of a rate hike at the BoE meeting on September 17. By contrast, markets heavily anticipate an ECB hike this week and are increasingly pricing in a Fed hike on the 17th of this month.

Foley of Rabobank warned that with Burnham’s government set to unveil its first annual budget on October 28 and markets already uneasy, a dovish signal from the BoE next week would “further expose the pound to risk”.

New finance minister John Healey told a speech on Monday that he will continue to uphold fiscal discipline while aiming to spread economic growth more evenly across the UK rather than concentrating it in the core economy of London.

Morgan Stanley economist Allan Monks said his comments indicate that, against a backdrop of rising borrowing costs, the government will take a cautious approach to tax and spending policy adjustments. The budget is likely to keep focusing on devolution, tighter public‑service oversight and more public‑private partnerships, with limited impact on the overall economic outlook.
Ryan of Ebury said the budget carries high political risk and may include “higher surcharge rates and increased borrowing” to fund Burnham’s spending plans.

He added that measures could involve changes to property purchase tax and local‑government tax, the introduction of a “luxury‑home tax”, and tighter tax breaks for pensions and individual investment accounts, and warned that if markets think such steps could curb growth, squeeze the private sector and require more borrowing, anxiety would rise.

items.title: 軟銀提前償還259億美元過橋貸款 積極置換OpenAI投資債務
items.title_en: SoftBank to Prepay $25.9 B of Bridge Loan, Actively Swaps OpenAI Investment Debt
paras: 日本軟銀集團周三(9日)宣布，將於9月15日提前償還為投資OpenAI所簽署400億美元過橋貸款(Bridge loan)(過渡融資)中，剩餘的259億美元本金。
過橋貸款的最終還款期限為 2027 年 3 月。財務長後藤義光在 8 月 6 日的全球電話會議上表示，公司規劃透過永久性融資方案，提早置換過橋貸款，方式包括銀行領銜的聯貸案、發行國內外公司債、保證金貸款及資產出售等。
這筆無擔保貸款是軟銀史上規模最大的美元計價借款，展現創辦人孫正義將公司推向全球AI浪潮核心的決心。
此外，軟銀預計下周於紐約與投資人會面，評估市場對發行100億至200億美元高收益債的意願。
針對軟銀積極延長債務期限的動作，彭博智庫(Bloomberg Intelligence)分析師Kirk Boodry指出：「在市場普遍擔憂財務槓桿的環境下，提早完成資金調度以避免不必要的波折，是較好的做法。」
在8月公布的第一季(4月至6月)財報中，軟銀財務支出增至3,287億日元，約為去年同期的兩倍。這主要是由於大規模借款、未償公司債增加，以及借貸利率上升導致利息支出增加等因素造成的。
paras_en: SoftBank Group announced on Wednesday (the 9th) that it will prepay the remaining $25.9 billion principal of the $40 billion bridge loan taken to fund its investment in OpenAI, with the repayment scheduled for September 15.

The bridge loan’s final maturity is March 2027. CFO Yoshimitsu Gotō said in the August 6 global conference call that the company plans to replace the bridge loan early through a permanent financing package that could include a bank‑led syndicated loan, issuance of domestic and overseas corporate bonds, margin loans and asset sales.
The unsecured loan is the largest dollar‑denominated borrowing in SoftBank’s history, underscoring founder Masayoshi Son’s determination to position the company at the core of the global AI wave.
SoftBank also expects to meet investors in New York next week to gauge market appetite for issuing high‑yield bonds worth $10 billion to $20 billion.

Commenting on SoftBank’s aggressive debt‑extension strategy, Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Kirk Boodry said: “In an environment where the market is broadly concerned about financial leverage, completing funding ahead of schedule to avoid unnecessary hiccups is the better approach.”

In the first‑quarter (April‑June) results released in August, SoftBank’s financial expenses rose to ¥328.7 billion, roughly double the amount a year earlier, driven by large‑scale borrowing, higher outstanding corporate bonds and rising borrowing costs that increased interest expenses.

items.title: 單一園區塞不下AI算力！GPU被迫跨區域部署 800G相干光模組浮現上修空間
items.title_en: Single Campus Can't Accommodate AI Compute! GPUs Forced to Deploy Across Regions, 800G Coherent Optical Module Shows Upside Potential
paras: 2026年09月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心缺電，正在意外引爆另一波光通訊需求。當單一園區拿不到足夠電力，雲端業者只能到各地搶租已通電的工業場址、比特幣礦場與既有資料中心，再用高速光纖把分散的GPU重新連成一套運算系統。AI光通訊需求也因此從機櫃內數公尺的連接，快速延伸至跨園區、跨城市的數百公里傳輸。
光通訊設備商飛速創新FS.COM(3355-HK)今日宣布擴充400G、800G及1.6T光收發模組產品線，並推出傳輸距離最長可達500公里的800G相干光模組，產品布局正好橫跨GPU叢集內部與不同資料中心之間的兩層連接需求。
第一層是GPU愈裝愈多，機櫃內外的頻寬必須同步升級。FS的400G、800G及1.6T光模組支援乙太網路、RoCE與InfiniBand，可連接GPU伺服器、網路介面卡、交換器及不同機櫃。當AI叢集持續增加GPU與機櫃數量，跨伺服器資料交換量快速放大，網路規格也由400G、800G一路推向1.6T。
更大的變化發生在園區之外。過去GPU主要集中在單一大型資料中心，現在電力容量不足迫使雲端業者把算力拆散到不同地區。原本在同一座園區內完成的模型參數、訓練資料與運算結果交換，開始變成跨園區資料中心互連(DCI)，長距離光纖、相干光模組及光傳輸設備也成為AI基礎建設的新瓶頸。
FS推出的500公里800G相干光模組，主要不是連接同一機櫃內的GPU，而是把不同園區甚至不同城市的資料中心串接起來。產品採用OSFP及QSFP-DD封裝，依網路架構與光纖條件，最長傳輸距離可達500公里，鎖定分散式AI運算與Scale-Across需求。
網路設備商Ciena(CIEN-US)的調查也反映需求正在轉向。95%的受訪電信業者預期，連接分散式AI運算叢集的服務將成為批發網路收入來源；88%認為現有光網路必須升級，其中39%認為需在未來12至18個月內完成。僅11%認為例行升級已足以承接AI流量。
若大型模型需要跨資料中心同步訓練，連線容量可能上看每秒數十Pb，並同時使用數百對光纖。這代表AI資料中心每增加一個分散場址，不只多出一批伺服器與GPU，也會新增場址之間的長距離傳輸需求。
過去資料中心優先蓋在網路條件最好的地方，現在AI資料中心卻必須跟著電力走，再把高速光纖拉到有電的場址。缺電表面上帶旺發電機、燃料電池與重電設備，背後也把原本集中的算力切成更多園區，進一步推高800G相干光、資料中心互連及光纖建置需求。

paras_en: September 9, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – AI data centers are facing power shortages, unexpectedly sparking a new wave of demand for optical communications. When a single campus cannot secure enough electricity, cloud providers are forced to lease already‑powered industrial sites, Bitcoin mining farms and existing data centers across the country, then stitch the dispersed GPUs back together into a single computing system with high‑speed fiber. Consequently, AI optical‑communication needs have expanded from a few meters of cabling inside a rack to hundreds of kilometers of transmission across campuses and cities.

Optical‑communication equipment maker FS.COM (3355‑HK) announced today a rapid expansion of its product line to include 400G, 800G and 1.6T optical transceiver modules, and introduced an 800G coherent optical module capable of up to 500 km transmission distance – a product lineup that precisely spans the two‑tier connectivity demand between GPU clusters internally and between separate data centers.

The first tier concerns the ever‑growing number of GPUs, requiring bandwidth upgrades both inside and outside racks. FS’s 400G, 800G and 1.6T modules support Ethernet, RoCE and InfiniBand, and can connect GPU servers, network interface cards, switches and different racks. As AI clusters keep adding GPUs and racks, cross‑server data exchange balloons, pushing network specifications from 400G and 800G up to 1.6T.

A bigger shift is happening beyond the campus. Historically GPUs were concentrated in a single large data center; now insufficient power capacity forces cloud providers to scatter compute across regions. Model parameters, training data and results that once exchanged within one campus now require inter‑data‑center (DCI) links, making long‑haul fiber, coherent modules and optical transport equipment a new bottleneck for AI infrastructure.

FS’s 500‑km 800G coherent module is not meant to link GPUs within the same rack but to connect data centers in different campuses or even different cities. The product uses OSFP and QSFP‑DD form factors, and depending on network architecture and fiber conditions can reach up to 500 km, targeting distributed AI workloads and scale‑across scenarios.

A survey by network equipment vendor Ciena (CIEN‑US) reflects the shifting demand: 95% of surveyed telecom operators expect services that connect distributed AI clusters to become a source of wholesale network revenue; 88% say existing optical networks must be upgraded, with 39% planning to do so within the next 12‑18 months. Only 11% believe routine upgrades will suffice for AI traffic.

If large models require cross‑data‑center synchronous training, link capacity could climb to tens of petabytes per second, using hundreds of fiber pairs simultaneously. This means each additional dispersed site adds not only a batch of servers and GPUs but also long‑haul transmission demand between sites.

In the past, data centers were built where network conditions were optimal; now AI data centers must follow power availability and then pull high‑speed fiber to those powered sites. The power shortage drives the deployment of generators, fuel cells and heavy‑duty equipment, and also fragments previously centralized compute into more campuses, further boosting demand for 800G coherent optics, data‑center interconnects and fiber deployment.

items.title: AI推論ASIC量產潮升溫！SEMIFIVE上半年接單逼近去年兩倍 三星4奈米首度放量
items.title_en: AI Inference ASIC Mass Production Surge! SEMIFIVE’s First Half Orders Near Double Last Year’s Full-Year Volume, Samsung’s 4nm Starts Volume Production
paras: 2026年09月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI推論晶片需求正由設計案轉化為量產訂單。南韓ASIC設計服務商SEMIFIVE宣布，已為HyperAccel量產資料中心AI推論加速器，採用三星電子Samsung Electronics(005930-KR)晶圓代工4奈米製程，晶粒面積超過500平方公釐，是SEMIFIVE首項採用三星4奈米製程的大規模量產專案。
訂單增幅直接反映AI ASIC需求暴增。SEMIFIVE今年上半年新增量產訂單達423億韓元（約10億元新台幣），接近2025年全年212億韓元的兩倍；第2季接單金額也由第1季的156億韓元增至267億韓元，季增71%。
海外訂單同步增加。SEMIFIVE第2季海外訂單占比達45%，顯示業務正由南韓向日本及其他市場擴張。公司表示，隨HyperAccel擴大服務部署，後續追加訂單可望推高量產規模，但實際出貨仍取決於客戶部署進度。
HyperAccel的加速器主要處理大型語言模型等AI推論工作。相較模型訓練，推論需要長時間回應大量使用者請求，雲端業者因而加速開發針對特定模型與工作負載的ASIC，以提高運算效率並降低單次推論成本。
這款加速器的晶粒面積超過500平方毫米，屬於大型晶粒(Big Die)。晶粒面積愈大，可整合的運算單元與記憶體介面通常愈多，但功耗、散熱與良率控制也更困難，每片晶圓能切割出的晶粒數量也會減少。
SEMIFIVE負責的範圍不只晶片設計，也涵蓋驗證、封裝、測試及量產供應。其商業模式類似台灣的創意(3443-TW)、智原(3035-TW)及世芯-KY(3661-TW)等ASIC設計服務商，協助缺乏完整晶片開發團隊的AI公司，將自研加速器導入先進製程並完成量產。
SEMIFIVE的AI晶片量產案已連續增加。繼2025年第3季為韓華視界Hanwha Vision(489790-KR)量產Wisenet 9監控攝影機AI ASIC後，今年第2季再為日本客戶量產HPC AI晶片，第3季則加入HyperAccel資料中心推論加速器。
從量產進度來看，SEMIFIVE過去取得的設計案正陸續轉為量產收入，應用也由監控攝影機延伸至HPC與資料中心AI推論。公司上半年量產訂單423億韓元，折合新台幣約10億元；相較台灣主要ASIC設計服務商單季營收約30億至100億元，SEMIFIVE規模仍小，不過，小型業者也開始取得先進製程量產案，印證AI ASIC需求正從少數雲端巨頭，擴散至不同產業、客戶與區域市場。

paras_en: September 9, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Demand for AI inference chips is shifting from design projects to mass‑production orders. South Korean ASIC design service provider SEMIFIVE announced that it has begun mass production of the HyperAccel data‑center AI inference accelerator, using Samsung Electronics (005930-KR) 4‑nm wafer‑fab process. The die area exceeds 500 mm², making it SEMIFIVE’s first large‑scale production project on Samsung’s 4‑nm node.

The order increase directly reflects a surge in AI ASIC demand. In the first half of this year SEMIFIVE added mass‑production orders worth 42.3 billion won (about NT$1 billion), nearly twice the full‑year 2025 figure of 21.2 billion won; the Q2 order value rose from 15.6 billion won in Q1 to 26.7 billion won, a 71% quarter‑over‑quarter increase.

Overseas orders are rising in tandem. In Q2, overseas orders accounted for 45% of SEMIFIVE’s total, indicating business expansion from South Korea into Japan and other markets. The company says that as HyperAccel’s deployment expands, follow‑on orders could boost production scale, though actual shipments will depend on customers’ rollout schedules.

HyperAccel’s accelerators mainly handle large language models and other AI inference workloads. Compared with model training, inference requires long‑running responses to many user requests, prompting cloud providers to accelerate development of ASICs tailored to specific models and workloads to improve compute efficiency and lower per‑inference cost.

The accelerator’s die area exceeds 500 mm², classifying it as a large die (Big Die). Larger die area allows integration of more compute units and memory interfaces, but also makes power consumption, thermal management and yield control more challenging, and reduces the number of dies that can be cut from each wafer.

SEMIFIVE’s responsibilities cover not only chip design but also verification, packaging, testing and mass‑production supply. Its business model is similar to Taiwan’s creative (3443‑TW), eMemory (3035‑TW) and SiPearl‑KY (3661‑TW) ASIC design service firms, helping AI companies lacking full chip‑development teams bring self‑developed accelerators to advanced processes and achieve volume production.

SEMIFIVE’s AI chip mass‑production projects have been continuously increasing. After mass‑producing the Wisenet 9 surveillance‑camera AI ASIC for Hanwha Vision (489790‑KR) in Q3 2025, the company mass‑produced an HPC AI chip for a Japanese customer in Q2 2026 and added the HyperAccel data‑center inference accelerator in Q3.

From a production‑progress perspective, SEMIFIVE’s previously won design projects are gradually converting into revenue, with applications expanding from surveillance cameras to HPC and data‑center AI inference. The company’s first‑half orders total 42.3 billion won (≈NT$1 billion); compared with Taiwan’s major ASIC design service firms that report quarterly revenues of NT$3 billion to NT$10 billion, SEMIFIVE remains smaller, yet even small players are securing advanced‑process volume projects, confirming that AI ASIC demand is spreading from a few cloud giants to diverse industries, customers and regions.
